text:
Grace: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Leadership wants a single-thread summary that spells out GA/beta windows, owners, and which items are absolutely blocking vs scope we can trim. Paste a 1-line status + MUST/CAN_DEFER.
Ethan: API status: aiming for GA in early Q3 (~5 weeks). Owner: Ethan (Platform). MUST: signed SLA + final billing meter names. CAN_DEFER: admin-only endpoints and experimental query params. We have a staging-only KV cache metric gap to close (instrumentation).
Noah: Gateway note: reproducer for intermittent stalls under mixed streaming + burst sync calls. Patch in review. If CI green I'll push to staging and run a 36h soak. Owner: Noah (Platform eng). Blocker? CAN_DEFER if we gate with canary, but prefer to fix pre-GA.
Priya: Runtime (Dedicated) note: need to validate GPU scheduling under the GA workload mix. Plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 48h observation windows. MUST: p99 tail within agreed SLO. Owner: Priya (Eng-runtime).
Lena: Console scope question: leadership said "core admin + rollout flows" by mid-Q3. Can we confirm whether per-route schema validation is required for GA? If yes, that's extra work.
Grace: Leadership clarified: GA = core admin, rollout UI, dashboards, per-route model settings. Per-route schema validation can be deferred to Q4 (CAN_DEFER) unless a paying customer requires it now.
Ethan: Beta features (structured output/tool-calling) are in private beta and will not block GA. We'll widen canary coverage to include these calls pre-GA.
Noah: Small ask: can we postpone the third-party APM link to Q4? That saves ~1 sprint and removes a dependency from Console GA.
Priya: Ops decision: APM link CAN_DEFER. We'll need to keep an internal hook for observability but external integration is optional.
finance-bot: FYI: Billing meter name changes need signoff 10 business days before GA. Please tag @Finance.
Grace: Optimize timeline: public beta = late-Q3, GA = Q4. Owner: Lena + Research. MUST for GA: 3 production evals showing cost improvements >= 5% on target workloads. Blocker: infra quota for tenant-level batched experiments.
Lena: We also need a minimal UI that shows estimated cost delta per recommendation. That UI can be simple (textbox + delta) for beta and expanded later. CAN_DEFER: full quantization matrix.
Ethan: Action items I'll track: 1) Noah to land gateway patch and post 36h soak link. 2) Priya to schedule Dedicated canary after patch promotion. 3) Finance to confirm meter names and pricing timeline. 4) Lena to open infra quota ticket for Optimize experiments. 5) Grace to publish consolidated checklist with owners and dates.
Noah: Patch in review now. If CI passes I'll push to staging at 09:30 and tag this thread.
Priya: Canary thresholds we'll use: error_rate > 0.4% OR p99 increase > 25% -> auto-rollback. We'll use a 5m cooloff and a 30m window before ramping.
Grace: Please annotate MUST vs CAN_DEFER in the checklist doc so Sales/Support get a clear handoff.
ops-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync Fri 09:00 PT.
Ethan: Quick risk note: legal SLA redlines are the toughest dependency. If Legal needs more time, GA shifts. PLEASE ping Legal early.
finance-bot: Marcus (Finance) assigned; he'll confirm meter names within 7 business days.
Lena: I'll draft the minimal Optimize UI prototype and attach it to the checklist. ETA: 5 business days. If infra quota delayed, beta moves by ~2-3 weeks.
Grace: I'll publish the checklist and owners by EOD tomorrow. Mark any slips here and I'll update the tracker. :thumbsup:
